acknowledge.en: The authors acknowledge the limitations of a single-site study.
acknowledge.zh: 作者承认单一站点研究的局限性。

acknowledge.en: Few studies acknowledge the role of chance in these outcomes.
acknowledge.zh: 很少有研究承认偶然因素在这些结果中的作用。

acknowledge.en: The report acknowledges contributions from all participating laboratories.
acknowledge.zh: 报告对所有参与实验室的贡献表示感谢。

assemble.en: We assembled evidence from forty peer-reviewed studies.
assemble.zh: 我们从 40 篇同行评审论文中汇集了证据。

assemble.en: Panels assemble to evaluate grant applications each spring.
assemble.zh: 评审组每年春季召开会议以评估基金申请。

assemble.en: The team assembled a database of cross-national survey results.
assemble.zh: 团队汇编了一个跨国调查结果数据库。

assist.en: Research librarians assist students in locating primary sources.
assist.zh: 研究馆员协助学生查找原始文献。

assist.en: A laboratory assistant assisted participants with the equipment during trials.
assist.zh: 试验中一名助手协助参与者操作设备。

assist.en: Software can assist but not replace careful data inspection.
assist.zh: 软件可以辅助而不能替代细致的数据检查。

associate.en: Sleep deprivation is associated with impaired concentration.
associate.zh: 睡眠不足与注意力受损相关。

associate.en: Respondents associated the brand with reliability rather than novelty.
associate.zh: 受访者将该品牌与可靠性而非新奇联系在一起。

associate.en: Higher intake was associated with better test performance overall.
associate.zh: 更高的摄入量总体上与更好的测验表现相关。

communicate.en: Clear figures help authors communicate complex results efficiently.
communicate.zh: 清晰的图表帮助作者高效传达复杂结果。

communicate.en: Cells communicate through chemical signals in the bloodstream.
communicate.zh: 细胞通过血液中的化学信号进行交流。

communicate.en: The study communicates its findings to both researchers and practitioners.
communicate.zh: 该研究向研究者和实践者双方传达其发现。

compile.en: We compiled a list of all eligible trials published before 2020.
compile.zh: 我们编制了 2020 年前发表的全部合格试验清单。

compile.en: The annex compiles statistics gathered across nine ministries.
compile.zh: 附录汇编了九个部门收集的统计数据。

compile.en: Librarians compile citation records for the university repository.
compile.zh: 馆员为学校知识库汇编引文记录。

consume.en: Model training consumes considerable computational resources.
consume.zh: 模型训练消耗大量计算资源。

consume.en: Households in the region consume more water than the national average.
consume.zh: 该地区家庭耗水量高于全国平均水平。

consume.en: The revision consumed most of the research time budget.
consume.zh: 修订工作耗费了大部分研究时间预算。

cooperate.en: Hospitals across the region agreed to cooperate on the registry.
cooperate.zh: 该地区各医院同意就登记库开展合作。

cooperate.en: Successful surveys depend on respondents willing to cooperate.
cooperate.zh: 成功的调查依赖于愿意配合的受访者。

cooperate.en: The two labs cooperate by sharing equipment and samples.
cooperate.zh: 两个实验室通过共享设备和样本进行协作。

create.en: Random assignment helps create comparable treatment and control groups.
create.zh: 随机分组有助于形成可比的处理组与对照组。

create.en: Feedback loops can create unintended inequalities in ranking systems.
create.zh: 反馈回路可能在排名体系中造成非预期的不平等。

create.en: The intervention created new opportunities for rural learners.
create.zh: 该干预为农村学习者创造了新的机会。

distort.en: Selective reporting can distort the apparent effectiveness of a treatment.
distort.zh: 选择性报告可能歪曲治疗表面上的有效性。

distort.en: Outliers may distort the estimated trend if not handled carefully.
distort.zh: 若不谨慎处理，离群值可能扭曲估计的趋势。

distort.en: Translation can distort nuanced items in attitudinal scales.
distort.zh: 翻译可能使态度量表中的精细条目失真。

expand.en: Later chapters expand on the theoretical framework.
expand.zh: 后续章节对理论框架作了进一步阐述。

expand.en: The sample will expand to include secondary schools next year.
expand.zh: 样本明年将扩大至包括中学。

expand.en: Demand for the service expanded rapidly after launch.
expand.zh: 该服务的需求在推出后迅速扩大。

participate.en: Over three hundred teachers participated in the survey.
participate.zh: 三百多位教师参与了这项调查。

participate.en: Volunteers were compensated for participating in the experiment.
participate.zh: 志愿者因参加实验而获得报酬。

participate.en: Not every eligible household chose to participate.
participate.zh: 并非每个符合条件的家庭都选择参与。

prescribe.en: Clinicians rarely prescribe antibiotics for viral infections.
prescribe.zh: 临床医生很少为病毒感染患者开抗生素处方。

prescribe.en: Ethics codes prescribe how conflicts of interest should be disclosed.
prescribe.zh: 伦理准则规定利益冲突应当如何披露。

prescribe.en: The protocol prescribes a washout period between conditions.
prescribe.zh: 方案规定各处理条件之间需安排清洗期。

secure.en: The team secured funding for a five-year follow-up.
secure.zh: 团队获得了五年期随访研究的资助。

secure.en: Securing informed consent precedes any data collection.
secure.zh: 取得知情同意先于任何数据收集。

secure.en: Researchers must secure records against accidental deletion.
secure.zh: 研究者必须确保记录安全以防误删。

association.en: The association between income and health is well documented.
association.zh: 收入与健康之间的关联已有充分文献记录。

association.en: Correlation does not imply a causal association.
association.zh: 相关并不意味着因果关联。

association.en: She joined a professional association of statisticians.
association.zh: 她加入了一个统计学家专业协会。

communication.en: Open communication reduces errors in clinical teams.
communication.zh: 开放的沟通可减少临床团队的差错。

communication.en: The project funds public communication of research results.
communication.zh: 该项目资助研究结果的公众传播。

communication.en: Communication delays between departments distorted the timeline.
communication.zh: 部门之间的沟通延误打乱了时间表。

community.en: The research community welcomed the open dataset.
community.zh: 学术界对这一开放数据集表示欢迎。

community.en: Local community leaders endorsed the recruitment plan.
community.zh: 当地社区负责人认可了招募计划。

community.en: Peer review sustains trust within the scientific community.
community.zh: 同行评审维系着科学共同体内部的信任。

author.en: Each author certified access to the raw data.
author.zh: 每位作者均确认可访问原始数据。

author.en: The first author drafted the coding scheme.
author.zh: 第一作者起草了编码方案。

author.en: Anonymous review conceals the identity of every author.
author.zh: 匿名评审隐去每位作者的身份。

conference.en: The findings first appeared as a conference paper.
conference.zh: 这些发现最初以会议论文形式发表。

conference.en: Conference presentations attracted useful methodological criticism.
conference.zh: 会议报告获得了有益的方法学批评。

conference.en: Submission deadlines for the spring conference have passed.
conference.zh: 春季会议的投稿截止日期已过。

department.en: The department revised its graduate admission criteria.
department.zh: 该系修订了研究生录取标准。

department.en: Funding comes jointly from two departments.
department.zh: 经费由两个系共同提供。

department.en: A hospital department piloted the new triage form.
department.zh: 一家医院科室试用了新的分诊表格。

economy.en: Inflation cooled as the economy slowed in 2023.
economy.zh: 随着 2023 年经济放缓，通胀有所降温。

economy.en: The study compares health outcomes across a market economy and a planned one.
economy.zh: 该研究比较了市场经济与计划经济体的健康结果。

economy.en: Household debt constrains growth in the whole economy.
economy.zh: 家庭债务制约着整体经济的增长。

emotion.en: Participants rated each image for emotion and familiarity.
emotion.zh: 参与者就情绪和熟悉度对每张图片评分。

emotion.en: Naming an emotion reduces its intensity.
emotion.zh: 为情绪命名能降低其强度。

emotion.en: The scale measures moral emotion rather than mood.
emotion.zh: 该量表测量的是道德情绪而非心境。

layer.en: A thin layer of sediment sealed the artifacts.
layer.zh: 一层薄薄的沉积物封存了这些人工遗物。

layer.en: The model adds a hidden layer between input and output.
layer.zh: 该模型在输入与输出之间增加了一个隐藏层。

layer.en: Analysis proceeded layer by layer through the archive.
layer.zh: 分析逐层推进，逐层深入档案之中。

output.en: Factory output recovered to its pre-crisis level.
output.zh: 工厂产出恢复到危机前水平。

output.en: We audited the model output for systematic bias.
output.zh: 我们对模型输出进行了系统性偏差审查。

output.en: Research output is measured in publications and citations.
output.zh: 科研产出以论文和引用衡量。

project.en: The longitudinal project tracked cohorts for two decades.
project.zh: 这项纵向项目追踪队列达 20 年。

project.en: Budget overruns delayed the construction project.
project.zh: 预算超支延误了该建设项目。

project.en: Each student presents an individual research project.
project.zh: 每位学生展示一个独立研究项目。

region.en: The effect held in every region surveyed.
region.zh: 该效应在所调查的每个地区都成立。

region.en: A desert region supplied most of the samples.
region.zh: 一个沙漠地区提供了大部分样本。

region.en: Policies differ markedly across the same economic region.
region.zh: 同一经济区域内的政策差异显著。

revenue.en: Tuition forms a shrinking share of university revenue.
revenue.zh: 学费占大学收入的比例不断缩小。

revenue.en: The tax reform shifted revenue toward local government.
revenue.zh: 税制改革将收入重心转移至地方政府。

revenue.en: Advertising revenue declined as subscriptions rose.
revenue.zh: 随着订阅量上升，广告收入有所下降。

reward.en: Delayed reward is central to intertemporal choice studies.
reward.zh: 延迟奖励是跨期选择研究的核心。

reward.en: Bonus schemes reward quantity more than quality.
reward.zh: 奖金方案奖励数量而非质量。

reward.en: The algorithm learns by maximizing a reward signal.
reward.zh: 算法通过最大化奖励信号进行学习。

sector.en: Employment grew fastest in the service sector.
Public-sector wages lag behind comparable private jobs.
sector.zh: 公共部门工资落后于可比的私营岗位。

sector.en: The policy targets emissions across every sector.
sector.zh: 该政策针对所有部门的排放。

site.en: Excavation began at the coastal dig site.
site.zh: 发掘工作始于沿海的发掘现场。

site.en: Each field site received identical training for enumerators.
site.zh: 每个田野站点为调查员提供相同培训。

site.en: The data are mirrored on a university web site.
site.zh: 数据已镜像同步到一所大学的网站上。

status.en: Migrant workers occupy an ambiguous legal status.
status.zh: 外来务工人员处于模糊的法律地位。

status.en: We recorded the completion status of every case.
status.zh: 我们记录了每个个案的完成状态。

status.en: Socioeconomic status remains the strongest predictor.
status.zh: 社会经济地位仍是最强的预测因子。

symbol.en: Each symbol denotes one logical operator.
symbol.zh: 每个符号表示一个逻辑运算符。

symbol.en: The flag operates as a political symbol.
symbol.zh: 这面旗帜发挥着政治象征的作用。

symbol.en: Notation varies: no single symbol is universal.
symbol.zh: 记法各异：没有任何符号是通用的。

theme.en: Trust emerged as a central theme in the interviews.
theme.zh: 信任成为访谈中的一个核心主题。

theme.en: Coding proceeded from surface codes to broader themes.
theme.zh: 编码从表层编码推进到更宽泛的主题。

theme.en: The exhibition explores the theme of migration.
theme.zh: 展览探讨了移民这一主题。

topic.en: The workshop rotates its topic every semester.
topic.zh: 该工作坊每学期更换主题。

topic.en: Topic modeling assigned each abstract to a cluster.
topic.zh: 主题模型将每篇摘要归入一个类别。

topic.en: Off-topic replies were excluded from analysis.
topic.zh: 离题的回复被排除在分析之外。

volume.en: Traffic volume doubles during the harvest season.
volume.zh: 收获季节交通流量会翻倍。

volume.en: The journal volume includes a memorial issue.
volume.zh: 该期刊的这一卷包含一期纪念专刊。

volume.en: High volume can compromise careful review.
volume.zh: 数量过大可能影响细致的评审质量。

chemical.en: Chemical analysis confirmed the presence of phosphates.
chemical.zh: 化学分析证实了磷酸盐的存在。

chemical.en: The compound shows remarkable chemical stability.
chemical.zh: 该化合物表现出显著的化学稳定性。

chemical.en: Chemical treatments increased weed resistance over time.
chemical.zh: 随着时间推移，化学处理提高了杂草的抗性。

digital.en: Digital archiving transformed access to manuscripts.
digital.zh: 数字化存档改变了手稿的可及性。

digital.en: The experiment compared digital and printed reading.
digital.zh: 该实验比较了数字阅读与纸质阅读。

digital.en: Digital traces allow precise measurement of behavior.
digital.zh: 数字足迹允许对行为进行精确测量。

dynamic.en: Group norms are dynamic rather than fixed.
dynamic.zh: 群体规范是动态的而非固定的。

dynamic.en: Prices adjust in a dynamic equilibrium model.
dynamic.zh: 价格在动态均衡模型中调整。

dynamic.en: The relationship between the two variables is highly dynamic.
dynamic.zh: 两个变量之间的关系是高度动态的。

molecular.en: Molecular evidence revised the species classification.
molecular.zh: 分子证据修正了物种分类。

molecular.en: The lab specializes in molecular diagnostics.
molecular.zh: 该实验室专攻分子诊断。

molecular.en: Results hold from the molecular to the behavioral level.
molecular.zh: 结果从分子层面到行为层面均成立。
